description: Use this when the user wants a metronome for practice with a tempo ladder from start to target BPM, a BPM or percent step and minutes per stage. Returns the ladder table, total time and CSV download. Supports ascending or descending 20 to 400 BPM with up to 200 stages; percent steps round to 0.001 BPM and target gets the full stage time. Does not track sessions or record audio.

minutes_per_step.description: Minutes spent at each stage, including the target, up to three decimal places. Example: 2.

start_bpm.description: Quarter notes per minute, 20 to 400, up to three decimal places. Example: 80.

step.description: Positive change per stage, in BPM or percent; percent is limited to 100. Up to three decimal places. Example: 5.

step_type.description: Step units, default bpm. Percent uses the previous stage with a 0.001 BPM rounding. Example: percent.

target_bpm.description: Quarter notes per minute, 20 to 400, up to three decimal places. Example: 120.

name: plan_tempo_practice
title: Plan tempo practice
